afterClose.zh-CN: 弹层完全关闭后的回调，两种模式都会调用。
afterClose.en-US: Called after the panel has fully closed, in both modes.

bodyStyle.zh-CN: 内容区域的样式，透传给当前模式的 Modal 或 SideSheet。
bodyStyle.en-US: Style of the content area, passed through to the Modal or SideSheet of the current mode.

cancelButtonProps.zh-CN: 取消按钮的属性。popup 模式下 loading 取内置挂起态与使用方的 loading 任一为真，onClick 先于内置处理调用。
cancelButtonProps.en-US: Props of the cancel button. In popup mode it is loading when either the built-in pending state or your loading says so, and onClick runs before the built-in handling.

checkboxGroupProps.zh-CN: type 为 checkbox 时多选组的属性，写法同 CheckboxGroup 的属性。选项组默认没有可访问名称，请用 aria-label 命名。
checkboxGroupProps.en-US: Props of the checkbox group for the checkbox type, written as the props of CheckboxGroup. The group has no accessible name by default; name it with aria-label.

children.zh-CN: type 为 custom 时的反馈内容。

class.zh-CN: 根元素的类名，与内置类名合并。
class.en-US: Class name of the root element, merged with the built-in class names.

closable.zh-CN: 是否显示关闭按钮，透传给当前模式的 Modal 或 SideSheet。
closable.en-US: Whether to show the close button. Passed through to the Modal or SideSheet of the current mode.

closeIcon.zh-CN: 关闭按钮中的图标，透传给当前模式的 Modal 或 SideSheet。
closeIcon.en-US: Icon inside the close button. Passed through to the Modal or SideSheet of the current mode.

closeOnEsc.zh-CN: 按 Esc 是否关闭弹层，透传给当前模式的 Modal 或 SideSheet。popup 模式需设为 true 才会在按 Esc 时触发 onCancel。
closeOnEsc.en-US: Whether Esc closes the panel, passed through to the Modal or SideSheet of the current mode. In popup mode it must be true for Esc to call onCancel.

footer.zh-CN: 替换默认的取消、提交按钮所在的页脚，透传给当前模式的 Modal 或 SideSheet。传入 null 时不渲染页脚。
footer.en-US: Replaces the footer with the default cancel and submit buttons, passed through to the Modal or SideSheet of the current mode. Passing null renders no footer.

getPopupContainer.zh-CN: 弹层挂载的容器，透传给当前模式的 Modal 或 SideSheet。
getPopupContainer.en-US: Container the panel is mounted into. Passed through to the Modal or SideSheet of the current mode.

height.zh-CN: 弹层高度，透传给 SideSheet。popup 模式内置为 auto，给出后以使用方的值为准。
height.en-US: Height of the panel, passed through to the SideSheet. Popup mode uses auto by default, and a value you give wins.

keepDOM.zh-CN: 关闭后是否保留 DOM，透传给当前模式的 Modal 或 SideSheet。
keepDOM.en-US: Whether the DOM is kept after closing. Passed through to the Modal or SideSheet of the current mode.

mask.zh-CN: 是否显示遮罩，透传给当前模式的 Modal 或 SideSheet。popup 模式内置为无遮罩，给出后以使用方的值为准。
mask.en-US: Whether to show the mask. Passed through to the Modal or SideSheet of the current mode. Popup mode has no mask by default, and a value you give wins.

maskClosable.zh-CN: 点击遮罩是否关闭，透传给当前模式的 Modal 或 SideSheet。
maskClosable.en-US: Whether a click on the mask closes the panel. Passed through to the Modal or SideSheet of the current mode.

maskStyle.zh-CN: 遮罩的样式，透传给当前模式的 Modal 或 SideSheet。
maskStyle.en-US: Style of the mask. Passed through to the Modal or SideSheet of the current mode.

mode.zh-CN: 展示模式：popup 是底部无遮罩的非模态面板（SideSheet），modal 是模态对话框（Modal）。未声明的属性按模式透传给对应的 SideSheet 或 Modal。
mode.en-US: Display mode: popup is a non-modal panel at the bottom without a mask (SideSheet); modal is a modal dialog (Modal). Attributes Feedback does not declare go to the SideSheet or Modal of the current mode.

motion.zh-CN: 是否启用动画，透传给当前模式的 Modal 或 SideSheet。
motion.en-US: Whether to animate. Passed through to the Modal or SideSheet of the current mode.

okButtonProps.zh-CN: 提交按钮的属性。未给 disabled 时按值禁用（值为空时禁用），给出后以使用方的值为准，type 为 custom 时用它控制提交；loading 取内置挂起态与使用方的 loading 任一为真；onClick 先于内置处理调用，不会替换内置处理。
okButtonProps.en-US: Props of the submit button. Without disabled, it is disabled while the value is empty; a disabled you give wins, which is how the custom type controls submission. It is loading when either the built-in pending state or your loading says so. onClick runs before the built-in handling, which still runs.

onCancel.zh-CN: 取消按钮、关闭按钮、Esc（modal 模式另有点击遮罩）触发；按 Esc 时参数为原生 KeyboardEvent。popup 模式返回 Promise 时取消按钮保持加载，fulfill 后才清空已填写的值，reject 时保留。关闭由 visible 控制，组件不会自行关闭。
onCancel.en-US: Called by the cancel button, the close button, Esc and, in modal mode, a click on the mask; the argument is a native KeyboardEvent for Esc. In popup mode a returned Promise keeps the cancel button loading, the filled-in value is cleared only once it fulfills, and kept when it rejects. Closing is controlled by visible; the component never closes itself.

onOk.zh-CN: 点击提交按钮时调用。popup 模式返回 Promise 时提交按钮保持加载，fulfill 后才清空已填写的值，reject 时保留；其他返回值立即清空。关闭由 visible 控制，组件不会自行关闭。
onOk.en-US: Called when the submit button is clicked. In popup mode a returned Promise keeps the submit button loading, the filled-in value is cleared only once it fulfills, and kept when it rejects; any other return clears the value at once. Closing is controlled by visible; the component never closes itself.

onValueChange.zh-CN: 反馈内容变化时的回调，参数为当前值：text 为字符串，emoji 为 `{ emoji, text }`（text 是选了「差」后填写的原因），radio 为所选项的值，checkbox 为所选值的数组。
onValueChange.en-US: Called when the feedback content changes with the current value: a string for text, `{ emoji, text }` for emoji (text is the reason filled in after choosing the bad face), the value of the chosen option for radio, and an array of chosen values for checkbox.

radioGroupProps.zh-CN: type 为 radio 时单选组的属性，写法同 RadioGroup 的属性。选项组默认没有可访问名称，请用 aria-label 命名。
radioGroupProps.en-US: Props of the radio group for the radio type, written as the props of RadioGroup. The group has no accessible name by default; name it with aria-label.

ref.zh-CN: 根元素的引用：popup 模式为 SideSheet 的根元素，modal 模式为 Modal 的最外层元素。
ref.en-US: Reference to the root element: the SideSheet root in popup mode, and the outermost element of the Modal in modal mode.

renderContent.zh-CN: 包裹反馈内容：接收内置内容（type 为 custom 时是子节点），返回包裹后的节点。
renderContent.en-US: Wraps the feedback content: receives the built-in content (the children for type custom) and returns the wrapped node.

role.zh-CN: 对话框的 role，可选 dialog 或 alertdialog，透传给当前模式的 Modal 或 SideSheet。
role.en-US: Role of the dialog, dialog or alertdialog. Passed through to the Modal or SideSheet of the current mode.

size.zh-CN: 弹层尺寸，透传给当前模式的 Modal 或 SideSheet。
size.en-US: Size of the panel. Passed through to the Modal or SideSheet of the current mode.

style.zh-CN: 内联样式，落在弹层的内容盒子上，位置见下方说明。
style.en-US: Inline style, applied to the content box of the panel; see the note below for where it lands.

textAreaProps.zh-CN: type 为 text 与 emoji 时多行输入框的属性，写法同 TextArea 的属性。
textAreaProps.en-US: Props of the multi-line input for the text and emoji types, written as the props of TextArea.

type.zh-CN: 反馈内容的类型。custom 时内容写在子节点中。
type.en-US: Type of the feedback content. For custom, the content goes in the children.

visible.zh-CN: 是否显示。组件不会自行关闭，由使用方在 onOk、onCancel 中把它设为 false。
visible.en-US: Whether the feedback is shown. The component never closes itself; set it to false in onOk or onCancel.

width.zh-CN: 弹层宽度，透传给当前模式的 Modal 或 SideSheet。
width.en-US: Width of the panel. Passed through to the Modal or SideSheet of the current mode.

zIndex.zh-CN: 弹层的层级，透传给当前模式的 Modal 或 SideSheet。
zIndex.en-US: Stacking order of the panel. Passed through to the Modal or SideSheet of the current mode.
